summary: FuelCell Energy filed an 8-K on July 9, 2026, reporting an underwritten public offering of 10,714,286 common shares at $21.00/share, with underwriters (Citigroup, Barclays) granted a 30-day option for 1,607,143 additional shares, fully exercised on July 8, 2026. Expected net proceeds of ~$245.4 million will fund manufacturing capacity expansion, working capital, and general purposes. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration (S-3ASR) and is expected to close July 9, 2026. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Risk-arb angle: none applicable.
